title: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise
notes: A technique id is ATT&CK-T<NNNN> with an optional .<NNN> sub-technique (REQ-DET-002). The item list is the complete Enterprise v20 technique set (706 techniques, 479 of them sub-techniques), extracted from MITRE's published v20 STIX bundle, so a technique id in a check's mapping or in the purple replay catalogue is validated against the release it claims (REQ-VALID-007) rather than against a number band. `tactics` is the v20 tactic vocabulary (15 tactics: Defense Evasion was split into Stealth and Defense Impairment in v18+); each item's `tactics` is the set MITRE assigns it, and `category` is the first of them. A short id such as ATT&CK-T123 is refused.
